signal: Flagright is expanding with new offices in New York, San Francisco and London after raising $4.3M seed, now serving fintechs in 30+ countries

email.body1:
Sean, saw Flagright is opening offices in New York, San Francisco, and London on the back of your seed round.

Expanding into new markets that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is exactly where enterprise deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Flagright off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: three drafts for your top accounts
email.body2:
Sean, quick follow-up for Flagright.

Expanding enterprise coverage across three new regions usually outpaces the reps you can put against it, and the follow-up touches that actually book meetings are the first thing to slip. That gap costs more pipeline than any list problem.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of Flagright's top enterprise targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them and the sequencing?
email.body3:
Sean, last bit of proof for Flagright.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Flagright's reply rate likely compares to other expanding fintech teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sean, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up three new offices is its own kind of busy, and I get that timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Flagright either way.
